usage: codeclone memory [-h] COMMAND ...

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    init               Initialize engineering memory.
    status             Show engineering memory status.
    migrate            Explicitly migrate the engineering memory schema to the
                       version this codeclone expects. The only sanctioned way
                       to change an EXISTING store's schema; a plain
                       status/search/read never does this.
    for-path           List memory records linked to a source path.
    search             Search engineering memory records by keyword.
    stale              List stale engineering memory records.
    vacuum             Purge expired stale/draft/rejected/archived records.
    coverage           Show memory coverage for repo-relative paths.
    review-candidates  List draft memory candidates awaiting review.
    approve            Approve a draft memory record.
    reject             Reject a draft memory record.
    archive            Archive an active memory record.
    semantic           Semantic retrieval index (status / rebuild / search).
    trajectory         Trajectory projections and analytics (status / rebuild
                       / list / search / show / agents / anomalies / dashboard
                       / export).
    jobs               Projection rebuild jobs (status / enqueue / run-once /
                       list).

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
